SddPreflightProtocol.keywords: preflight, adversarial, domain-checklist, lazy, extensible, failure-modes
SddPreflightProtocol.Mission: Before internal critic, close design consequences predictable from selected domain capabilities. Input — accepted decisions, coverage map, active amplifications, and drafted spec. Output — no delta, or one consolidated decision packet. The core stays platform-neutral.

BeliefState.Axiom: Load only checklist modules whose trigger is present. An inactive domain costs no read, no question, and no placeholder output.
Each checklist owns one domain and declares Trigger, ProbeSet, and ClosureEvidence. New languages and platforms add checklist directives without changing this algorithm.
Reuse accepted answers. Collect every genuinely open product fork across active checklists and ask once. Fix mechanical omissions without Ask.

SddPreflightProtocol.ChecklistCatalog: | Domain | Directive | Trigger | |---|---|---| | storage | `ai/directives/sdd-v2/amplify-storage.directive.xml` | persisted state, cache, database, files, synchronization | | security | `ai/directives/sdd-v2/amplify-security.directive.xml` | trust boundary, credentials, external input, authorization | | nfr | `ai/directives/sdd-v2/amplify-nfr.directive.xml` | latency, throughput, scale, availability, resource budget | | observability | `ai/directives/sdd-v2/amplify-observability.directive.xml` | production diagnosis, telemetry, alerts, operational recovery |

Step.Action: Match catalog triggers against accepted decisions and the draft. No match → return CLEAN (`AX_PREFLIGHT_LAZY`).

For each match, `READ_AND_USE_DIRECTIVE` that one directive and reuse its already-answered coverage as a checklist, not a replayed interview. Probe boundary conditions, ordering/concurrency, failure/recovery, deletion/retention, compatibility/migration, and operator visibility only where meaningful. Platform checklists extend the catalog through the Trigger/ProbeSet/ClosureEvidence contract (`AX_PREFLIGHT_EXTENSIBLE`).

Fix mechanical omissions directly. If product forks remain, return one grouped Ask with the new consequence that opened each fork; cite accepted decisions instead of re-confirming them (`AX_PREFLIGHT_ONE_PACKET`). Record answers in the Decision Log. No fork → return CLEAN without Ask.
